items.title: Nobel Prize awarded for showing inner workings of the brain
items.dek: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded for their work.

items.title: US air force removes all bombers from British military base RAF Fairford
items.dek: No reason has been given for the withdrawal, but it follows a major incident last week when police were alerted to "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase.
